messages:
matt: CI red on linux-release after the toolchain image roll. failing target: `//server:core`
ci-bot: Build failed: //server:core (linux-release) — exit code 1 — https://ci.internal/redwood/12345
jess: ugh, top error? paste the compile error pls
matt: `error: undefined reference to 'std::__cxx11::basic_string...`
        seems like a linker complaining about libstdc++ ABI
sarah: that looks like a C++ ABI mismatch. did the gcc image bump to 13 land in the roll?
toni: CI matrix shows gcc13 on linux-release only, macos still using clang. is macos failing too?
matt: macos-sim also had a related link error but slightly different symbol. linux-release is deterministic failing, macos is noisy.
ryan: can someone run a quick local reproduce with `bazel build --config=linux-release //server:core` and `ldd` the binary? might be a runtime library mismatch from the toolchain image
jess: before we spin up local reproduces, can we check if remote cache had a mismatch? I've seen stale cache + toolchain changes cause strange link errors. try `bazel clean --expunge` and rerun in CI for one build?
sarah: agree. also request a fast bisect: we need to bisect the toolchain image roll commits to confirm the exact change.
matt: starting a bisect job now, targeting commits: `main~30..main`. kicking off with `tools/ci/bisect --target //server:core --shard linux-release`
ci-bot: Bisect job queued by @matt — https://ci.internal/redwood/bisect/789
ryan: if bisect points to the image bump, we should pin the CI to the previous image while we triage. someone want to open a quick PR to pin `tools/ci/images.yaml`?
toni: I can open the PR, will pin to `gcc-12.2-2025-02` and trigger the matrix rerun.
jess: also upload the `bazel build --verbose_failures` logs here, helps narrow which objects fail to link
matt: pasted shortened log: ```
/opt/gcc-13/lib64/libstdc++.so.6: undefined reference to `__cxa_unexpected'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```
sarah: that `__cxa_unexpected` symptom screams mixed libstdc++ ABI or missing exception runtime symbol. likely toolchain runtime mismatch.
ryan: running the bisect locally; will post result in ~10m. if it isolates to the image bump commit, we can revert or pin.
ryan: bisect result: break introduced at commit `a1b2c3d` — image update from `gcc-12.2` -> `gcc-13.0` + new `libstdc++` packaging change.
matt: thanks, that matches local repro. opening an incident PR to pin CI images and add a follow-up to validate ABI compatibility in the release checklist :eyes:
toni: PR filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/422 — pins image and triggers rerun.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by @toni — build 12346 queued
jess: after rerun please check flaky tests too; run `bazel test //... --test_output=errors` on pinned image to ensure nothing else regressed
matt: rerun green on pinned image. will keep thread for follow-ups and add a note to the toolchain rollout doc to include ABI smoke tests. thanks all :thumbsup:
